output.title: Vault issuer presence unclear in environment
output.content: The change adds a configuration option to cert-manager's Vault issuer. The environment summary shows only `certificates.cert-manager.io` CRD but notes this is partial ("1 of 1 shown"). Vault issuer support would require a VaultIssuer or ClusterIssuer with Vault backend, which is not listed. Verify whether your cluster uses Vault issuers (check for vaultissuer.cert-manager.io, clusterissuer.cert-manager.io with Vault spec, or Vault issuer resources in your manifests) to determine applicability.
